insight: Built by Rome-based Translated on 25M professional human translations; its 2025 'Lara Think' reasoning step cut errors 50–60%.
name: Lara Translate
tagline: AI translator for text, documents, audio, and images across 200+ languages.
description: A translation app and API from Translated that pairs context-aware machine translation with an optional reasoning step and three style modes — Faithful, Fluid, and Creative. Translates text, documents, audio, and images from one shared character quota, with web, mobile, CLI, and MCP access. Trained specifically on professional translation data rather than repurposed from a general-purpose LLM.

modelSupport.notes: Proprietary translation models (Lara, plus the Lara Think reasoning model) trained on professional translation data.

edge: Trained only on professional translation data with a reasoning step and three style modes — not a repurposed general LLM.

references.title: Translated Redefines Translation AI Quality With Lara
